item.description: The product: name, price, and optional description, period, and media. Omit it to render the built-in sample order.

adjustments.description: Automatic lines, each with id, label, amount (negative for a discount), and optional note.

coupon.description: Enables the promo code field. onApply resolves { ok: true, code, label?, amount } or { ok: false, message }. Validate on your server.

tax.description: Tax line. With rate the amount is computed from the discounted subtotal; without it note, or Calculated at checkout, is shown.

title.description: Heading, also the section's accessible name.

payLabel.description: Pay button label. Receives the formatted total.

onPay.description: Client-side payment. Resolve to show success, reject to show an error and Try again.

form.description: Posts a native form instead, such as to a route that creates a hosted checkout session. fields become hidden inputs.

secureNote.description: Line beside the lock under the button.

disabled.description: Shows the button but blocks payment, such as before checkout opens.
